scoring_justification: Headline quantities (adsorption/desorption energies, step reaction energies, mechanism energetics) are computed from DFT total energies that cannot be reproduced in the verifier sandbox; recomputing from raw DFT outputs is infeasible. The checker reads the agent's reported numbers and compares them to the paper's gold values with directional tolerances.

hidden_assets.purpose: Reference gold values for adsorption/desorption energies, elementary reaction energies, and mechanism-level energetics, taken from Tables III and IV of the source paper (DOI: 10.1007/s11663-009-9321-4).
hidden_assets.source_provenance: Paper Table III (adsorption/desorption total energies and derived values) and Table IV (general reaction energies and surface-only energies).
hidden_assets.generation_method: Direct extraction from the paper's published data; the paper reports E_ads(AlCl) = -9.355 eV, E_des(AlCl) = 9.355 eV, E_des(AlCl3) = 8.054 eV; step reaction energies: A2 0.346, A3 0.541, A4 0.213, B2 0.490, B3 -0.247, C2 0.490, C3 -0.827; mechanism energies: A surface_only 1.45 general -18.58, B surface_only 0.24 general -19.78, C surface_only 0.15 general -19.86.
hidden_assets.why_not_fabricated: These are the paper's own reported numbers, verifiable from the published article (open-access). Reproducing the work must replicate these values within tolerances that absorb toolchain differences (different DFT code, pseudopotentials).

outputs.description: Adsorption and desorption energies of AlCl and AlCl3 on Al(110) computed from DFT total energies.
Elementary reaction energies and forward activation energies for steps A2‑A4, B2‑B3, C2‑C3 computed from DFT total energies.
Surface-only and general reaction energies for mechanisms A, B, C of 3AlCl(g) → 2Al(∗) + AlCl3(g) on Al(110).

output_contract.notes: All energies are reported in eV. The checker compares against reference values with tolerances accounting for toolchain differences (open-source DFT code vs. proprietary CASTEP). Activation energies are forward barriers (E_a) from Table II.
